metadata.technology_specification: System on Chip (SoC) package for smartphone application processor
metadata.technology_reasoning: Smartphone application processors are predominantly delivered as System on Chip (SoC) packages integrating CPUs, GPUs, AI engines, and memory controllers in a single silicon die. The SoC package includes not only the silicon die but also the substrate, interposers or package materials, and the external interfaces required for integration into a smartphone motherboard, representing the standard form factor and supply chain unit.

components.reasoning: The silicon die containing CPU, GPU, AI DSP, and other logic blocks is the fundamental component and functional heart of the SoC package, always present and procured as a single unit.

The substrate provides mechanical support, electrical routing, and interconnects between the silicon die and the smartphone PCB, universally included in all SoC packages as a separate manufactured component.

components.component: Ball Grid Array (BGA) or Land Grid Array (LGA) Solder Balls
components.reasoning: These conductive solder balls or lands enable electrical and mechanical connection to the smartphone mainboard and are standardized in SoC packages, procured and handled separately in assembly.
The polymer or adhesive material attaching the silicon die to the substrate is a key subassembly element but sometimes integrated differently depending on package design.
Protective resin applied to enhance mechanical stability and protect internal connections is common in SoC package assemblies, though the exact material and process can vary.

components.component: Heat Spreader or Integrated Heat Sink
components.reasoning: Some SoC packages include an integrated thermal solution such as a copper heat spreader as a separate component to manage heat dissipation, but this can be externally added or omitted.
